description: Defines the Http2VisitorInterface class with callback methods for handling HTTP/2 protocol events, such as headers, data frames, stream management, and connection errors.

classes.name: Http2VisitorInterface
classes.description: An interface with callback methods for handling HTTP/2 events and frames, used by HTTP/2 protocol processors.

methods.name: OnReadyToSend
methods.description: Called when serialized frames are ready to be sent; returns number of bytes sent or error codes.

methods.name: OnConnectionError
methods.description: Handles connection-level errors with specific error codes.

methods.name: OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Invoked when a frame header is received; can be overridden.

methods.name: OnSettingsStart
methods.description: Called at the start of a SETTINGS frame.

methods.name: OnSetting
methods.description: Handles individual SETTINGS id-value pairs.

methods.name: OnSettingsEnd
methods.description: Called at the end of a SETTINGS frame.

methods.name: OnSettingsAck
methods.description: Handles SETTINGS acknowledgment frames.

methods.name: OnBeginHeadersForStream
methods.description: Called when headers for a stream are received.

methods.name: OnHeaderForStream
methods.description: Handles individual header key-value pairs for a stream.

methods.name: OnEndHeadersForStream
methods.description: Indicates the end of headers for a stream.

methods.name: OnBeginDataForStream
methods.description: Called at the start of a DATA frame for a stream.

methods.name: OnDataPaddingLength
methods.description: Handles padding length in DATA frames.

methods.name: OnDataForStream
methods.description: Handles data payload for a stream.

methods.name: OnEndStream
methods.description: Indicates the end of data for a stream.

methods.name: OnRstStream
methods.description: Handles RST_STREAM frames.

methods.name: OnCloseStream
methods.description: Handles stream closure.

methods.name: OnPriorityForStream
methods.description: Handles PRIORITY frames.

methods.name: OnPing
methods.description: Handles PING frames.

methods.name: OnPushPromiseForStream
methods.description: Handles PUSH_PROMISE frames.

methods.name: OnGoAway
methods.description: Handles GOAWAY frames.

methods.name: OnWindowUpdate
methods.description: Handles WINDOW_UPDATE frames.

methods.name: OnBeforeFrameSent
methods.description: Called before a frame is sent.

methods.name: OnFrameSent
methods.description: Called after a frame is sent.

methods.name: OnInvalidFrame
methods.description: Handles invalid frames received.

methods.name: OnBeginMetadataForStream
methods.description: Handles beginning of metadata frames.

methods.name: OnMetadataForStream
methods.description: Handles metadata payload for a stream.

methods.name: OnMetadataEndForStream
methods.description: Indicates end of metadata for a stream.

methods.name: OnErrorDebug
methods.description: Logs or handles application error messages.
